dr-aamir.name: Dr. Aamir
dr-aamir.title: Pediatric Rehabilitation Specialist
dr-aamir.bio: Dr. Aamir is a dedicated Pediatric Rehabilitation Specialist who completed his Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree at Sargodha Medical College. He specializes in childhood motor development delay, cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, and post-injury pediatric rehabilitation in home environments across Lahore.
dr-aamir.meta_title: Dr. Aamir - Pediatric Rehabilitation Specialist | Home Physio Lahore
dr-aamir.meta_desc: Book home pediatric physical therapy with Dr. Aamir, DPT (Sargodha Medical College). Specialist in cerebral palsy, pediatric rehab & motor delay care in Lahore.

dr-muhammad-mudasir.name: Dr. Muhammad Mudasir
dr-muhammad-mudasir.title: Sports Physiotherapist
dr-muhammad-mudasir.bio: Dr. Muhammad Mudasir earned his DPT degree from Sargodha Medical College and has 3 years of clinical experience specializing in sports injuries, athletic muscle strains, ligament sprains (ACL/MCL/Ankle), and biomechanical conditioning. He brings high-frequency electrotherapy and sports taping to patient homes.
dr-muhammad-mudasir.meta_title: Dr. Muhammad Mudasir - Sports Physiotherapist | Home Visit Lahore
dr-muhammad-mudasir.meta_desc: Book sports physiotherapy at home with Dr. Muhammad Mudasir, DPT (Sargodha Medical College, 3 years exp). Ligament sprains, muscle strain & athletic recovery.

dr-muhammad-mubashir.name: Dr. Muhammad Mubashir
dr-muhammad-mubashir.title: Post-Operative & Surgery Rehabilitation Specialist
dr-muhammad-mubashir.bio: Dr. Muhammad Mubashir is a senior physical therapist with 5 years of specialized clinical experience in post-operative and surgical rehabilitation. A graduate of Sargodha Medical College, he has successfully led early post-op recovery for over 1,200 Total Knee Replacement (TKR), Total Hip Replacement (THR), and complex fracture patients at home.
dr-muhammad-mubashir.meta_title: Dr. Muhammad Mubashir - Post-Surgery Rehab Specialist | Lahore Home Physio
dr-muhammad-mubashir.meta_desc: Book in-home post-operative rehabilitation with Dr. Muhammad Mubashir, DPT (Sargodha Medical College, 5 yrs exp). Knee & hip replacement recovery in Lahore.

dr-muhammad-irfan.name: Dr. Muhammad Irfan
dr-muhammad-irfan.title: Stroke, Frozen Shoulder & Muscle Pain Specialist
dr-muhammad-irfan.bio: Dr. Muhammad Irfan completed his DPT from Sargodha Medical College and brings 6 years of expertise in managing neurological stroke recovery, adhesive capsulitis (frozen shoulder), acute myofascial trigger points, and chronic back/neck muscle pain. He utilizes portable digital TENS, ultrasound, and manual therapy techniques.
dr-muhammad-irfan.meta_title: Dr. Muhammad Irfan - Stroke & Frozen Shoulder Physio | Home Visit Lahore
dr-muhammad-irfan.meta_desc: In-home stroke rehabilitation & frozen shoulder relief with Dr. Muhammad Irfan, DPT (Sargodha Medical College). Effective muscle pain management across Lahore.

dr-rashid.name: Dr. Rashid
dr-rashid.title: Senior Neuro Rehabilitation Specialist
dr-rashid.degrees: DPT (Sargodha Medical College), MS Neurological Physiotherapy (Riphah International University)
dr-rashid.bio: Dr. Rashid is a highly qualified Senior Neuro Rehabilitation Specialist. After earning his DPT at Sargodha Medical College, he completed his MS in Neurological Physiotherapy from Riphah International University. He has 8 years of clinical experience treating post-stroke paralysis, hemiplegia, Parkinson's disease, and spinal cord injuries.
dr-rashid.meta_title: Dr. Rashid - MS Neuro Rehabilitation Specialist | Home Physio Lahore
dr-rashid.meta_desc: Book home neuro rehab with Dr. Rashid, DPT (Sargodha Medical College), MS Neuro Physio (Riphah University). Expert stroke paralysis & nerve rehab in Lahore.
